title: The Legend of Zelda: Korok Forest
alt: A sword with a blue-violet guard stands point down in a low stone platform in a green forest glade, and a shaft of light falls on it. Behind it is a very large tree with a face, mossy roots and pink blossom. Small wooden creatures with leaf masks stand in the grass, and white and blue flowers grow near the platform.
summary: A painting of Korok Forest from The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Korok Forest in the Great Hyrule Forest, from The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, a game by Nintendo. The Master Sword stands in a stone platform in front of the Great Deku Tree.
Koroks live in this forest. The white and blue flowers are Silent Princess flowers. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
